purpose: Correctness migration with full cost disclosure; no optimization claim.
variants: Qualified E31 current production Hypermesh and corrected candidate production Hypermesh, with identical Cargo dependency/feature fingerprints. Completed targets are read-only.
process_order: baseline/candidate alternating by pair, separately for unchanged control and expanded matrix
cache_conditions: Each process is fresh. Cold phases construct 8 new meshes per matrix case (16 for control); warm phases reuse these mesh identities. Process scalar caches and earlier cases are not reset. No new retained cache is introduced.
timing: Cold construction, complete query, certainty/value/error materialization and retained source vector; warm complete query and result materialization. Query and independent expected-value construction precede timing. Atomic allocator instrumentation is included in both variants.
metrics: released requested bytes at source drop
native probe and WASM artifact sizes
comparison: Compare latency only when both observations complete the same expected value Certified. Keep wrong or typed-failure baselines, all individual pairs and unfavorable results; they are not faster successful completion.
limits: Per-command external elapsed 180s and virtual-address 8GiB; no internal total-work, heap-byte, cancellation or expression-growth bound is claimed.
